# AssistQ

> AssistQ is an AI-powered lead-qualification chatbot and CRM dashboard for small and mid-sized local businesses (real estate, clinics, salons, home services, consultants, coaching). Built and operated by SonQAI Technologies.

AssistQ engages every website visitor the moment they land, has a real qualifying conversation (budget, timeline, requirement), scores the resulting lead, and delivers only the qualified leads to the business by email and WhatsApp — 24/7. Setup is typically live within 48 hours.

## Plans
- Starter (₹999/mo + ₹1,999 setup): chatbot only, no dashboard, 15-day free trial.
- Growth (₹3,499/mo + ₹2,999 setup): chatbot + full dashboard (SEO audit, keyword tracking, UTM analytics, sales pipeline, EMI calculator).
- Premium (₹6,999/mo + ₹4,999 setup): everything in Growth plus team management, automation, WhatsApp Cloud API, commission tracking, RERA compliance checker.
